provenance.method: Original official MPD2023 workbook, Notes units, literal Full data rows and source bibliography reviewed against the existing independent statistical-territory/entity/year approvals. Only approved exact-year country units with nonconflicting missing economy slots enter this bounded intake. Names, modern ISO identity and geometry do not generate new territorial approvals. Source-country GDP estimates retain actual years, 2011 international-dollar units and original national reconstruction bibliography; no invented constitutional, currency, interval, total GDP or population claims. All unapproved mappings and unavailable years stay outside production.
